twoCoreNodeEstimate.topology: Active/standby Nitro core across two AZs; three Redis copies (primary plus two replicas) across three AZs; one multi-AZ ALB; EKS standard; private subnets with two NAT gateways. Not a fully isolated enterprise RPC/relay deployment.
twoCoreNodeEstimate.redisNote: Small coordinator pricing example only; sustained throughput and message retention must be sized. Higher memory nodes may be needed.
twoCoreNodeEstimate.backupNote: S3 stores explicit application/state backups; EC2 local instance-store NVMe is not protected by EBS snapshots.

optionalRelayAndProxyBudget.note: Lightweight relay/proxy example, not full Nitro RPC nodes; sustained CPU-credit charges can add cost.

optionalThirdCoreNode.roles: Separate validator or third sequencer; role separation must be finalized

planningTotals.suggestedUserFacingRounded: About $2,550/month base, or $3,700/month with a third full-size node, before usage-dependent services and operations.

availability.officialNitroDefaultUnplannedFailoverGap: Up to lockout-duration (default about one minute), plus coordinator interval and startup; Redis or lack of synced standbys can stop sequencing.

hetznerValueAlternative.caveat: Do not attach the AX102-1 price to the ECC -3 SKU. Limited pricing depends on stock; older generic AX102 hardware pages do not resolve per-SKU pricing. Self-managed failover/Redis/monitoring and support must be priced separately.
